content: The recommended dosage for ORAVIG is the application of one 50 mg buccal tablet to the upper gum region (canine fossa) once daily for 14 consecutive days. ORAVIG should be applied in the morning after brushing the teeth. The tablet must be handled with dry hands. The rounded side of the tablet should be placed against the upper gum, just above the incisor tooth (canine fossa), and held in place with slight pressure over the upper lip for 30 seconds to ensure proper adhesion. Although the tablet is rounded on one side for comfort, either side of the tablet can be applied to the gum. Once applied, ORAVIG remains in position and gradually dissolves. Subsequent applications should alternate between the left and right sides of the mouth. Before applying the next tablet, any remaining material from the previous tablet should be removed. ORAVIG should not be crushed, chewed, or swallowed. Food and drink can be consumed normally while ORAVIG is in place, but chewing gum should be avoided. If ORAVIG does not adhere or falls off within the first 6 hours, the same tablet should be repositioned immediately. If it still does not adhere, a new tablet should be applied. If the tablet is swallowed within the first 6 hours, the patient should drink a glass of water and apply a new tablet only once. If ORAVIG falls off or is swallowed after being in place for 6 hours or more, a new tablet should not be applied until the next regularly scheduled dose.
